title: Fourier compatibility classifies the entire covariance boundary
statement: For actual periodic G and S=<GG^T>,all values and real/imaginary Fourier coefficients lie in L=range S. If dim L<=2 and det restricted to L vanishes identically,every value is rank one. Otherwise determinant has exactly two rank-one projective lines spanning L; compatibility forces G=R1 a(k1.x)+R2 b(k2.x) with independent circle profiles and mean zero. Ordinary rays R_i,weights m_i2 and backgrounds[m_i3/(3m_i2)]R_i match covariance/all cubics; Cauchy–Schwarz and nonnegative mixed quartic term give E<=2<F>/3 and the uniform c/6 gap for EVERY such field. This is an analytic universal proof,not inferred from the replay examples. Small covariance eigenvalues give L2 information and do not justify arbitrary L4 concentration/rank-collapsing limits or a general full-rank modulus. Scope precision: qualitative rank-at-most-two Jensen also follows directly by sequential rank-one convexity of the independent one-dimensional profiles. The retained refinements are the explicit ordinary capacity construction and quantitative c/6 quartic gap,not a general new ROC/QC equivalence. Rank-three conic statements cover only the stated invertible-annihilator/scalar-Hessian face,and global optimization INFIMA after positive-epsilon extension; singular-annihilator faces and zero-epsilon attainment are outside that claim.
